title: Content Engine: qualify before signup
summary: The Content Engine front door, gate only. Five questions find the person whose posting earns money, who has no time to do it and can pay for it: a business owner, a paid creator or someone who posts for clients. Hobbyists leave, not-yet goes to a waitlist.

body.title: Is your business silent on social because you have no time?
body.eyebrow: FOR BUSY OWNERS WHO SHOULD BE POSTING
body.subheadline: 5 questions, under a minute. They decide whether Content Engine is worth your week, before you set anything up.

questions.text: What does posting on social media do for your income?

options.label: It brings customers to my business or practice
My content is my income: brand deals, courses, paid work
Clients pay me to post for them
Nothing yet, I am still building an audience
Nothing, I post for fun

questions.text: A busy week arrives. What happens to the posting?

options.label: It stops. The work wins every time
I pay someone, and I still chase and correct them
It goes out late, rushed, or on one channel only
Nothing slips. Every post goes out on time, everywhere

questions.text: What does getting posts out cost you today? Think of the idea, the caption, and a thumbnail resized for every platform.

options.label: My own hours, which I do not have
Money: a freelancer, an agency or an employee
My team's time, pulled away from their real work
Nothing. We do not post, and that costs me nothing

questions.text: What does your business or work bring in during a normal month?

options.label: Under ₹50,000
₹50,000 to ₹1 lakh
₹1 lakh to ₹5 lakh
More than ₹5 lakh

questions.text: Content Engine is about ₹3,775 a month with GST for one brand, after a 7-day trial. Where do you stand?

options.label: I decide, and that is less than this problem costs me now
I decide. I will use the 7 days, and pay if it does the job
Someone else has to approve the spend
I am looking for something free

disqualifiedContent.heading: This is not built for you, and that is fine.
disqualifiedContent.subtext: Content Engine is for people whose posting earns them money and who have no time left to do it.
disqualifiedContent.bodyHtml:
From your answers, that is not your situation today. You do not need a paid engine posting for you every day, and we would rather say so now than after you have set it up.

Nothing has been stored and nobody will follow up.

exits.name: Waitlisted
exits.heading: Not a no. A not yet.
exits.subtext: The need is real. One piece is missing today: the income to carry it, or the person who signs off.
exits.bodyHtml:
Leave your details and you keep your place. When that piece is in place, come back through the same door and you will not be asked to start over.

Until then, the main page shows everything the engine does.
